movers.headline: clarifies that Minerva Ventures Fund's proposed preferential allotment of 33,28,686 warrants will leave it with 4.31% post-issue holding (revised from 4.35%), following further exchange queries; the issue remains pending in-principle approval, no change in board composition or control
closes the subscription window on its Rs 1,279.40 cr Rights Issue (opened 12-Oct, Rs 750/share); the issue's outcome and allotment are still pending
signs a binding term sheet with Gruner Renewable Energy for a 50:50 JV to build 10 Compressed Bio-Gas plants (18 MT/day each) across India, an estimated Rs 1,200 cr capital outlay for the JV company

completes a Rs 1,115 cr QIP (14,81,72,756 units at Rs 75.25, a 2.36% discount to the floor price) to fund acquiring six Hybrid Annuity Model road assets from the Sponsor, expanding its portfolio from 12 to 18 assets

approves a Rs 450 cr capex to consolidate its fragmented Karnataka lamination operations into one integrated facility, lifting sheet-metal capacity from 1,08,000 to 1,60,000 MT/year, phased through FY2030-31 (internal accruals + debt)
wins a 1-year Letter of Award from NHAI as user-fee (toll) agency for the Limha Fee Plaza on the Bilaspur-Pathrapali stretch of NH-130, Chhattisgarh, worth Rs 94,97,29,635
approves the terms of a Rs 69.28 cr Rights Issue (86.60 lakh shares at Rs 80, 1:1 ratio); issue opens 4-Nov, closes 18-Nov, not yet subscribed
secures a Rs 4.81 cr rooftop-solar order from the Gujarat Energy Development Agency, including a 10-year maintenance contract, 12-month delivery
receives two same-day orders from an international buyer for specialized safety shoes -- Rs 2.14 cr + Rs 0.70 cr = Rs 2.85 cr combined -- for delivery by December 2026

order_wins: **GPT Infraprojects** — Rs 27.08 cr order from AFCONS-KTPL (JV) for dual-gauge pre-stressed concrete sleepers, 10-month delivery (~1.8% of mcap).

**Magellanic Cloud** — wholly owned subsidiary Provigil Surveillance emerges as L1 (lowest) bidder on a Bank of Maharashtra e-surveillance tender covering 1,550+ sites, bid value ~Rs 115 cr (~8.2% of mcap); award is subject to a formal order, not yet issued.
**Trom Industries** — Rs 4.81 cr rooftop-solar order from the Gujarat Energy Development Agency, 10-year maintenance contract, 12-month delivery (~9.1% of mcap).
**Acme Universal Safezone 9** — two same-day orders from an international buyer for specialized safety shoes, Rs 2.14 cr + Rs 0.70 cr = Rs 2.85 cr combined (~1.4% of mcap).
**Safety Controls & Devices** — receipt of Letters of Intent/Award aggregating ~Rs 10.16 cr (~5.8% of mcap).
**Lakshya Powertech** — informs the Exchange of receipt of an order/contract (filing PDF failed to parse this pass; amount not confirmed).

**Bondada Engineering** — receives a Letter of Intent from Gujarat Industries Power Company for a 20 MW/120 MWh Vanadium Redox Flow Battery EPC package (plus 10-year O&M) at its Vadodara plant, described as India's largest grid-scale VRFB project to date; order value not disclosed in the text read.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Ola Electric Mobility** — intimation under Regulation 77B(2) confirming an application submitted by a Specific Investor (terms not detailed in the text read).
**Bonlon Industries** — cancels a scheduled Rights Issue Committee meeting; no new date given, no raise currently in progress.
equity_allotments: **D & H India** — withdraws its proposed preferential issue of up to 21,57,000 convertible warrants (Rs 151 each, ~Rs 32.57 cr), citing rejection.
**Century Extrusions** — Rights Issue Committee outcome: allotment of equity shares on a rights basis (amount not stated in the text read).

**360 ONE WAM** — allots 2,05,02,939 equity shares to UBS AG on conversion of warrants issued July-2025 (not new capital), at Rs 1,030/share, ~Rs 2,111.80 cr; paid-up capital rises from Rs 40.79 cr to Rs 42.84 cr.

**Chandra Bhagat Pharma** — board allots 66 lakh convertible warrants (Rs 44 each, ~Rs 29.04 cr if fully converted) on preferential basis, almost entirely to promoter-family allottees; Rs 7.26 cr minimum subscription received so far, conversion into shares pending the balance consideration.
**EPIC Energy** — allots 4,00,000 equity shares to a warrant holder on conversion, ~Rs 1.5 cr received (25% tranche at Rs 12.5/warrant).
m_and_a: **Anka India** — receives an NCLT order in relation to its Scheme of Amalgamation (next procedural step, no new terms disclosed).
**Power Finance Corporation** — PFC Consulting (its wholly owned subsidiary) incorporates a further wholly owned subsidiary, Northern Region Power Transmission Limited (minor administrative step).
**Ugro Capital** — NCLT fixes 20-Nov as the final hearing date for its scheme of amalgamation.
capex_core: **Shakti Pumps (India)** — invests Rs 12 cr in wholly owned subsidiary Shakti EV Mobility.
**Juniper Green Energy** — commissions additional wind capacity (figures not stated in the text read).

**Sat Kartar Life** — proposes a new 30-bed Ayurveda hospital-cum-therapy centre in Amritsar (~13,000 sq ft), estimated investment Rs 1.5 cr funded from IPO proceeds, targeted operational by 31-Mar-2027 (~0.7% of mcap — below the top-mover notability bar, kept as a theme line).
business_updates: **Results season** — 89 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, per the baseline's own count, not itemised here.

**Infinity Infoway** — H1 FY27 revenue up 106.22% YoY to Rs 16.81 cr, EBITDA up 109.68% to Rs 8.52 cr (50.65% margin), PAT up 79.36% to Rs 5.02 cr (EBITDA/PAT not in the bu_metrics vocabulary — revenue only is saved as data).

**Kheria Autocomp** — H1 FY27 revenue of Rs 72.27 cr, up 31.38% YoY, at 98.9% capacity utilisation; plans a 44% capacity addition at Sanand-II (Rs 65 cr, funded from IPO proceeds + promoter infusion), commercial production targeted Jan-2027.

**Patel Retail** — press release on expansion into Nashik and Raigad districts; FY26 Total Income Rs 1,059.29 cr, EBITDA Rs 83.08 cr, Net Profit Rs 39.05 cr (trailing-year figures, not new-store economics).
**Paisalo Digital** — reports 42% YoY growth in disbursements; AUM up 33% YoY to Rs 72,659 mn.

**Jainik Power Cables** — press release says it has secured government orders from Haryana worth over Rs 25 cr (filing text not in this pass's cache; carried from the baseline's own headline, unread).
distress_risk: **Hitech Corporation** — receives a corrigendum to the outcome of its Reverse Book Building Process (delisting-related).
**Jindal Photo** — the manager to its delisting offer submits the Detailed Public Announcement under Regulation 15 of the SEBI Delisting Regulations to BSE.
**Quadrant Televentures** — convenes the 18th meeting of its Committee of Creditors (ongoing CIRP).
**Ashapura Intimates Fashion** — trading in its equity shares remains suspended pending an NCLT-ordered reduction of share capital (no filing link in the baseline's own data).
**Future Consumer** — informs the Exchange of a Committee of Creditors meeting (ongoing CIRP).
**Satiate Agri** — post-facto intimation of the outcome of its 2nd Committee of Creditors meeting (ongoing CIRP).
credit_rating_changes: **Ramco Systems** — credit-rating revision on Rs 150 cr bank facilities.
**Kirloskar Electric Company** — credit-rating revision received from CRISIL on Rs 115.63 cr facilities.
**Share India Securities** — credit-rating disclosure under Regulation 30.
**Alpex Solar** — credit-rating press release under Regulation 30 (rating specifics not in the text available this pass).
other_notable: **Automobile Corporation of Goa** — record date set for its equity-share buyback.
**Advanced Enzyme Technologies** — ongoing open-market buyback of equity shares.
**Great Eastern Shipping** — daily buyback report for shares bought back 22-Oct.
**Man Infraconstruction** — ongoing open-market buyback of equity shares.
**Global Pet Industries** — completes extinguishment of 8,40,000 equity shares bought back.
**Purple Finance** — intimation of a change in its registered office (address change only).
**Shreeji Global FMCG** — adopts a new line of business (details not stated in the text read).
**Vedanta** — notice of board meeting, trading-window closure and investor-call schedule ahead of its financial results.
**BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle** — board approves raising up to Rs 300 cr via non-convertible debentures (debt, not equity) on a private placement basis; terms to be finalised at issuance.
